title: Revolut hits a $115B valuation, up from $75B in November 2025, after a secondary share sale led by Glade Brook, Coatue, and others, as it plans a US bank launch (Jagmeet Singh/TechCrunch)
summary: Jagmeet Singh / TechCrunch: Revolut hits a $115B valuation, up from $75B in November 2025, after a secondary share sale led by Glade Brook, Coatue, and others, as it plans a US bank launch — Revolut's investors have completed a secondary share sale that values the British fintech at $115 billion …
